title: Claude Reel 2 - Spending a year on one offer? You're doing it wrong.
subtitle: STORYBOARD ONLY (no video yet) · Instagram version · Evidence Board style
hook: Why a year spent building ONE offer is a year spent guessing (alt: "I spent months building. I never asked ONE buyer a question.")
thumbText: One YEAR One Offer? Wrong. (circled) + doctor with syringe + stranger + HEARD / ASSUMED stamps + "lie down."
linkNote: IG ends: comment PERFECT. Other platforms: asheraw.com/link (first tab).
why: Evidence Board (pinned polaroids, sticky notes, red stamps on a dark board), a new look for this series. The reel's whole point is sorting claims into HEARD (proof, green) and ASSUMED (guess, red): that is exactly what an investigation board does. Runner-ups: Halftone Dossier (used for Reel 1, would feel repeated), Game Show (too playful for 'you wasted a year'), Whiteboard (plain). Say if you prefer another.

checklist.t: You in lower half, soft top edge
